**Finding: deviation (LOL-CAP)** — Section 11.5 (p0572) is the document's only limitation-of-liability provision.

- **What exists:** a mutual waiver of indirect/incidental/special/punitive/consequential damages, with carve-outs for fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, breach of Article 9 / Section 5.8 (confidentiality), and third-party damages payable under an Article 11 indemnity.
- **What is absent:** any monetary cap on either party's direct liability. Searches for "aggregate liability", "shall not exceed" and every "liable"/"liability" hit return nothing; Article 13 contains only force majeure, and the rest of Article 11 is indemnity procedure and insurance.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** the fallback requires a mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs; here there is no cap at all, a material failure (not merely sub-preferred wording). The exposure is mutual, so it is not walk-away territory.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** one sentence appended to Section 11.5 capping each party at the greater of 12 months' payments by AbbVie and USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and AbbVie's Article 6 payments excluded from "damages".
